content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current payment infrastructure in Tanzania is heavily reliant on platforms like Stripe and PayPal, which impose significant restrictions on sellers, particularly those outside of their supported regions. These restrictions limit access to international buyers, significantly reducing revenue potential. In contrast, the sovereign digital commerce stack offered by COREMERCH bypasses these platforms altogether, allowing sellers to collect payments directly from buyers without the need for intermediaries. This results in significantly lower transaction fees and greater control over the payment process.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to sign up for a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to nowpayments]] account, which will serve as the foundation for your blockchain-based payment system. You'll also need to choose a suitable cryptocurrency for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/accepting-bitcoin-ebook-sales-step-step-deployment-guide-2|Accepting Bitcoin]] payments, such as USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Additionally, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare account to leverage their powerful infrastructure for hosting and delivery. All of these components are easily integrated into the COREMERCH stack, making it easy to get started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments in your chosen cryptocurrency. This will involve creating a new payment address and configuring the associated payment settings. Next, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare Workers script to manage the delivery of your digital products, ensuring seamless and secure delivery to your customers. Finally, you'll need to configure your Supabase instance to store order information, allowing you to easily manage your sales and customer data.
Tanzanian online sellers can now break free from restrictive payment platforms and collect payments directly from international buyers.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live. To process your first transaction, simply create a new payment request in your NOWPayments account and share the associated payment link with your customers. As soon as the payment is confirmed on-chain, you'll receive a webhook notification, triggering the delivery of your digital product to the customer. This process is seamless and secure, allowing you to focus on growing your business and expanding your customer base.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with increasing demand. This is where the Complete Builder Kit comes in – a comprehensive bundle of blueprints, templates, and guides that will help you build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With this toolkit, you'll be able to easily add new payment methods, expand your product offerings, and optimize your delivery pipeline for maximum efficiency. By leveraging the power of blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure, you'll be able to scale your business to new heights, even in the face of restrictive payment platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: sign up for a NOWPayments account and choose a suitable cryptocurrency for accepting payments, configure your Cloudflare account to leverage their powerful infrastructure for hosting and delivery, create a new payment address and configure the associated payment settings in your NOWPayments account, set up a Cloudflare Workers script to manage the delivery of your digital products, and configure your Supabase instance to store order information. By following these steps, you'll be well on your way to creating a seamless and secure payment and delivery pipeline for your digital products.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my Cloudflare account?

Integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare account is straightforward. Simply sign up for a NOWPayments account, choose a suitable cryptocurrency for accepting payments, and configure your Cloudflare account to leverage their powerful infrastructure for hosting and delivery. Then, create a new payment address and configure the associated payment settings in your NOWPayments account. This will enable you to accept payments directly from buyers and deliver your digital products seamlessly and securely.
What are the benefits of using blockchain-based payments?

The benefits of using blockchain-based payments include reduced transaction fees, greater control over the payment process, and the ability to accept payments directly from buyers without the need for intermediaries. This not only saves you money but also gives you more flexibility and autonomy in managing your payment and delivery pipeline.
How do I store order information for my digital products?

You can store order information for your digital products using a Supabase instance. Simply configure your Supabase instance to store order data, and then use this data to manage your sales and customer information. This will enable you to easily track your sales and customer activity, making it easier to grow your business and expand your customer base.
Can I use multiple payment methods in my sovereign digital commerce stack?

Yes, you can use multiple payment methods in your sovereign digital commerce stack. To do this, simply configure your NOWPayments account to accept multiple payment methods, and then update your Cloudflare Workers script to handle the associated payment settings. This will enable you to offer your customers multiple payment options, making it easier for them to purchase your digital products.
How do I optimize my delivery pipeline for maximum efficiency?

To optimize your delivery pipeline for maximum efficiency, you'll need to configure your Cloudflare Workers script to manage the delivery of your digital products. Simply update the script to handle the associated payment settings, and then test your delivery pipeline to ensure that it's working seamlessly and securely. This will enable you to deliver your digital products quickly and efficiently, even in the face of increasing demand.
